description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing dependency picklists in the vtiger CRM system, including AJAX requests for CRUD operations and UI interactions for selecting and mapping values.

methods.name: changeDependencyPicklistModule
methods.description: Triggers AJAX request to update dependency picklist data based on selected module.

methods.name: addNewDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Initiates AJAX request to add a new dependency picklist for the selected module.

methods.name: editNewDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Prepares and sends AJAX request to edit a new dependency picklist with selected source and target fields.

methods.name: editDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to edit an existing dependency picklist with specified source and target fields.

methods.name: deleteDependencyPicklist
methods.description: Confirms and sends AJAX request to delete a specified dependency picklist.

methods.name: saveDependency
methods.description: Serializes dependency mapping data and sends AJAX request to save it.

methods.name: serializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current picklist dependency mapping data into JSON format.

methods.name: selectSourceValue
methods.description: Selects a source value checkbox based on index.

methods.name: selectTargetValue
methods.description: Highlights the target value cell matching the specified value.

methods.name: unselectTargetValue
methods.description: Removes highlight from the target value cell.

methods.name: loadMappingForSelectedValues
methods.description: Displays mapping cells for selected source values.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles click event on a cell, toggling selection and tracking modified cells.

methods.name: handleCellMouseDown
methods.description: Tracks mouse down event for cell drag selection.

methods.name: handleCellMouseOver
methods.description: Handles mouse over event for drag selection of cells.

methods.name: handleCellMouseUp
methods.description: Resets mouse down state after drag selection.
